spells.procedure:

NEW stationary60x60horizontal by20ft vertical box, center perceived within120ft/LoE. Before price record complete bounded actual terrain surfaces/air/gaps and one personally experienced mundane terrain depiction using at most8 explicitly finite surfaces/volumes, not a hidden world reconstruction. Center LoE and each actual ordinary sensory path are required; real opaque barriers clip expression. No effect paints over independently moving creatures, held objects, buildings/doors/mechanisms or actual light sources. All NEW lifetime is concentration600elapsed seconds, overriding insufficient Instantaneous.
Visual texture/topography and ordinary apparent sound/smell use the actual accessible sight, hearing and air paths within the box; no wall penetration, new light or source knowledge. Blinded observers may still hear/smell/feel through usable channels, Deafened hear nothing. Tactile depiction is meaningful: contact with a specified apparent surface gives its recorded texture, perceived pressure up to1lb-force sensation and perceived temperature15..30°C, plus at most2inch ripple/roughness sensation. These are sensory only, with no actual net force, heat, buoyancy, collision, lift, excavation, material, water, bridge, damage or added movement cost. Actual support, heights, terrain-rate, solid obstructions and work govern every step. An apparent raised surface cannot raise a foot; reaching a real gap starts the native fall rather than supporting weight. Real impact/lost footing, penetration of an apparent rigid surface, or inability of a putative floor to bear a foot is conclusive personal contradiction. Merely feeling the intended texture is not disproof.
Each observer can use an ordinary Investigation Action versus source DC with actual usable evidence; success or conclusive contradiction durably identifies this source. Its false imagery remains distinguishable, sounds/smells remain recognized as generated, and tactile sensation remains identifiable alongside genuine physical contact; no hazard/location/map not actually perceived is revealed. Actual True Seeing identifies accessible channels within its moving60ft extent; it does not globally dispel or repair prior falls/injury.
NEW one actual control Action per original regular turn may revise the same finite composition within its original box/known terrain, no extra RP and no new duration/recognition reset; no control through missing actual line/perception. No image or copied performance supplies this Action. Across this source own applications the latest successfully established component presents each overlapping channel, with earlier live source clock retained. NEW this Mirage source locally yields its visual depiction wherever an actually operative Hallucinatory Terrain already depicts that same surface, independent of cast order; Mirage sound/smell/touch remain because Hallucinatory Terrain grants none. This concession changes only Mirage output, not the accepted other source. Partial Antimagic removes only this source expression at actually intersecting points while concentration/deadline continue. Actual ally/consent admission is an explicit finite actor fact, not a secret faction/motive oracle. Willingness and alliance are admission-only gates; later withdrawal or attitude change does not retarget or automatically end this fixed application. NEW attention veil: ordinary conscious observers cannot newly NOTICE a protected recipient through its sight,sound,smell or noncontact sensory emission while operative, rather than merely suffering a Stealth penalty. The recipients can perceive one another normally through actual senses/cover; this does not reveal the group to outsiders. Bodies remain fully physical/targetable and leave real evidence. No total cover, damage/area/healing immunity, removal of actual collision, forced belief or erased memory. A known-location ordinary attack/area effect still uses its genuine targeting/geometry; a perceive-creature spell needs actual perception, not assumed last-position sight.
NEW observation matrix is observer-specific and permanent for that observer/recipient in the same genuine encounter after a qualifying interaction or genuine live-application perception. Directed intelligible speech to an actual hearing outsider counts for that outsider; incidental unheard speech/ordinary conversation does not. Deliberate or accidental real bodily touch/collision with a conscious observer counts in either direction. A directed attack attempt by or against a protected body counts for the consciously interacting participant when actual ordinary evidence of that attempt reaches it, even on a miss, before its attack modifiers are determined; an uninformed failed search at an empty old square is no identity oracle. Actual hit or targeted positive healing counts for the acting observer who has its own lawful targeting/perception; Veil supplies no missing targeting. An actual area packet striking that body counts for its conscious original source observer only if that observer has an actual sensory witness of that bodily interaction; it does not broadcast hidden target lists or reveal the whole group. An unconscious person gains no new conscious observation but retains prior memory.
Held/worn nonliving gear is covered only while actually carried. Genuine transfer to an outsider is an interaction revealing the involved recipient to that receiving observer; the same item is ordinary noticeable gear once released. Dropped gear becomes noticeable without globally revealing a body. Footprints, displaced dust, bent grass, doors and recorded/mechanical evidence remain actual unprotected evidence; inference can guide lawful location-targeting, never grants current body sight by itself. A noncognitive pressure plate/bell/camera records actual mass/light/sound normally; it is not a mind and receives no attention veil. Its trigger does not itself give every observer body recognition. A real-time ordinary sensory feed applies the live body attention rule to its observer. A stored past recording is ordinary detached evidence, always examinable without this spell concealing or rewriting its frames; it grants no current body sight or position beyond its real recorded time. No retrospective record deletion.

Genuine contact/TrueSeeing/suppression-enabled perception creates a durable exact observer/recipient recognition receipt, with ordinary continuing senses/cover still required. It reveals only that body and actual observed gear, not other roster members, identity/class/motives or hidden contents.

Preserve same-encounter continuity through relabels/callbacks. Death ends that recipient, caster death/concentration loss/source removal/expiry ends that source group. Another caster independent source does not erase the same observer actual recognition, stack attention barriers or refresh a deadline. No revealing one recipient ends all others.
